notes.title: The latest in the "Atelier" series, “Atelier Resleriana” is now free-to-play!
notes.notes:
Adventure, Alchemy, Everyday

KOEI TECMO GAMES and Akatsuki Games present the latest title in the Atelier series!
A story of the two protagonists Resna and Valeria, and the simple yet profound game system of gathering, synthesis, and battle. Plus, encounter many characters from past Atelier games.

For new starters only! Two of the highest rated ★3 characters (Rorona + another character) are guaranteed!

Begin your alchemy adventure by playing this free-to-play game now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2594920/

Official Site：https://resleriana.atelier.games/en

Official X：https://twitter.com/Resleriana_EN

©KOEI TECMO GAMES / Akatsuki Games Inc.

notes.title: Update information Ver.1.08 (2023/2/15)
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash if the player party was defeated in a specific event.
- Fixed an issue in which the descriptions of some skills, effects, and traits differed from their actual specifications.
- Fixed display issues.

notes.title: The latest entry in the Atelier series, Atelier Ryza 3, has been announced!
notes.notes:
The final summer, the final secret…

This is the third JRPG title in the “Secret” series, which consists of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121560/]Atelier Ryza[/url] released in 2019 and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1257290/]Atelier Ryza 2[/url] in 2021, and illustrates the final adventure of Ryza and her friends. 

For more information about Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key visit:

■Steam page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1999770/

■Official Website: https://www.koeitecmoamerica.com/ryza3/

notes.title: Update information Ver.1.07 (2022/5/30)
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash when trying to use "Mosaic Umbrella" ("Atelier Plachta" DLC completion bonus) in the main game.
- Fixed an issue in which the descriptions of some skills, effects, and traits differed from their actual specifications.
- Fixed a playback issue that occurred when the BGM was changed in certain scenes.
- Fixed display issues.
- Other minor adjustments and bug fixes.

notes.title: Update information Ver.1.06a (2022/4/28)
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue in which the game would crash if you attempted to change to any of the following costumes while not owning the "White Canvas" Sophie's swimsuit:
Plachta's Swimsuit "Clivia Nobilis"
Ramizel's Swimsuit "Agapanthus Romance"
Alette's Swimsuit "Rainmaker"
Olias's Swimsuit "Vegetable Garden"
Diebold's Swimsuit "Knight Commander"

notes.title: Update information Ver.1.06 (2022/4/28)
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue in which costumes linked to the save data of different title could be unlocked by mistake.
- Fixed an issue in which the effects of some Effects and Traits didn't match the effects listed in the explanation.
- Fixed an issue in which the Autoplay button didn't work correctly during some event scenes.
- Fixed an issue in which Plachta could synthesize the "Barrage Talisman" item.
- Fixed an issue where the AP acquisition status sometimes did not match the landmark discovery status on the world map.
- Fixed an issue in which Wild Hail didn't appear after receiving the "Rematch at Snowy Corridor!" quest.
- Fixed an issue in which trophies and achievements for "Ruler of the Dream" could not be obtained on the Legendary difficulty.
- Fixed an issue in which graphics could appear corrupted after the weather was changed in a specific way.
- Improved compatibility with the new DLC.
- Fixed display issues.
- Other minor adjustments and bug fixes.

notes.title: Update information Ver.1.05 (2022/4/7)
notes.notes: - Added the "Tales of Arise" collaboration accessories.

notes.title: Update information Ver.1.04 (2022/3/17)
notes.notes:
- Added the Boss Rush Battle mode.
- Added Plachta's "Nature Goddess's Bouquets" & "Geometric Pom-Poms" accessories.
- You can now change the BGM.
After applying this update, you will be able to select "BGM" from the desk in your atelier.
You can change the in-game BGM used in specific scenes to some other tracks in Atelier Sophie 2.
- Improved compatibility with the new DLC.
- Fixed display issues.
- Other minor adjustments and bug fixes.

notes.title: Update information Ver.1.02 (2022/3/10)
notes.notes:
- Fixed the issue that allowed duplicate settings for some items in key assigment settings on the Steam version.
- Improved compatibility with the new DLC.
- Fixed display issues.
- Other minor adjustments and bug fixes.

notes.title: Update information Ver.1.03 (2022/3/10)
notes.notes:
- The name of the additional costume for Plachta included with Digital Deluxe and Digital Deluxe with Season Pass was changed to “Black Monokini – New”.
- Improved compatibility with the new DLC.
- Fixed display issues.
- Fixed the issue where some SE did not play correctly.
- Other minor adjustments and bug fixes.

notes.title: Update information Ver.1.01 (2022/2/28)
notes.notes:
- Added new maximum difficulty level.
- Added photo mode enhancement update.
- Made adjustments to accommodate the "BLUE REFLECTION: Second Light" Early Purchase Joint Bonus.
- Fixed an issue in which the fire effect level of a Pickaxe could be incorrectly shown as "none" at Lv. 18.
- Fixed an issue in which, when playing on Charismatic difficulty or higher, the game would stop during the synthesis tutorial if you used the Beast Meat obtained from a battle.
- Fixed an issue for the Steam version in which, for some devises, character models would sometimes not be displayed correctly after setting the Anti-Aliasing option under the Graphics Settings to "TAA".
- Fixed display issues.
- Other minor adjustments and bug fixes.
